iut_type: End Product (IDEAL Corporation device), Bluetooth-unrelated optional accessories and registration scope
customer_question: Our product comes with an optional resin cover accessory -- does this need to be included/described in the Bluetooth SIG registration?
question_variants: Does every accessory sold with the product need to be mentioned in the registration, or only Bluetooth-relevant ones?
actual_issue: The customer wanted to know whether an optional accessory bundled with their product, but unrelated to its Bluetooth functionality, needed to be described or accounted for in the Bluetooth SIG registration.
plain_english_explanation: Bluetooth SIG registration scope is tied to the product's Bluetooth functionality and implementation -- accessories that have no connection to the Bluetooth feature set, such as a purely protective resin cover, do not need to be included or described in the registration at all.
consultant_answer: No, optional accessories like a resin cover that have no connection to the Bluetooth functionality don't need to be included in the registration.
decision_logic: Registration scope covers the product's Bluetooth-relevant implementation only -- accessories unrelated to Bluetooth functionality fall outside that scope and require no mention.
final_recommendation: When a customer asks whether a bundled accessory needs registration mention, check only whether it has any connection to the Bluetooth functionality being registered, not whether it's sold alongside the product.
risk_if_done_wrong: Including irrelevant accessory details in a registration submission would add unnecessary complexity without any compliance benefit.
bluetooth_tags: accessory unrelated to Bluetooth excluded from registration
search_aliases: does optional accessory need to be in Bluetooth registration
